text:
Asha (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager: north-eu-gpu-pool saturated — autoscaler not adding nodes, queue growing and 429s reported. Noticed spikes at 20:04 UTC.
IncidentBot: Pager opened for tag `gpu-pool-north-eu` (severity: high). Escalation to on-call SRE and ML on-call.
Ravi (sre): On it. Seeing `scale_limit_reached` in autoscaler logs and repeated provider `InstanceLimitExceeded`. Queue depth jump: 3k -> 12k in 5m.
Sam (ml-oncall): Confirmed elevated latency and throttled requests. Some jobs are being evicted and requeued, causing amplification. Model variant routing fallback isn't firing consistently.
Tomas (infra): Provider reports per-region GPU quota hit. We have transient capacity but quota prevents spin-up. Opening case with cloud support, requesting immediate quota bump and explaining production outage.
Emma (cs): Got 2 customer pings about 503s for embed calls. Notified top-10 accounts and routed them to status page.
Asha (oncall): Quick mitigation ideas: 1) force-route new requests to smaller model shard (less memory), 2) enable permissive eviction override to accept lower-priority jobs, 3) throttle non-critical background jobs. Thoughts?
Sam (ml-oncall): Agree. We should enable the fallback policy to `gpt-small-quant` for low-latency routes and flip auto-failover to 'always' for the next 10 minutes. Also reduce `max_batch_size` on heavy routes to avoid head-of-line blocking.
Ravi (sre): Implementing temporary rate-limits on internal batchers and pausing low-priority queues. Patching autoscaler to bypass `scale_cooldown` for immediate scale up when queue > 10k. Will monitor.
Nora (eng-ops): Adding short note to deployment gating to avoid big model rollouts during surge window.
Tomas (infra): Cloud case responded: quota increase approved + immediate soft quota for 2x GPUs, ETA 7 minutes. Meanwhile suggest enabling cross-region spillover to west-eu.
Asha (oncall): Can somebody run the spillover? Sam/Tomas?
Tomas (infra): Triggering cross-region spillover now. Routing policy updated: prefer west-eu pools at cost tier +1.
Sam (ml-oncall): Flipped fallback routing and reduced batch sizes. Patch applied to route table:
```
route_policy:
  prefer_regions: [west-eu]
  fallback_model: gpt-small-quant
  aggressive_failover: true
```
Ravi (sre): Applied autoscaler bypass patch (hotfix). Logs show new node requests queued to provider. Eviction rate dropping. Queue depth peaked at 12.3k now decaying.
IncidentBot: Update: provider quota change applied. Additional capacity provisioning in progress.
Emma (cs): Customers updated. Received thumbs up from 3/3 major accounts acknowledging mitigation.
Asha (oncall): Monitoring for 15m. If queue back to <1k and 95p latency normal, we can start rollback of the hotfix and throttle policies.
Tomas (infra): New instances booted and joined pool. North-eu pool capacity +120% compared to baseline.
Sam (ml-oncall): Traffic progressively migrating back. Fallback model serving ~8% of embed calls now.
Ravi (sre): Queue at 900, tail latency within SLOs. Will keep autoscaler bypass for additional 10m then revert.
Asha (oncall): Marking incident as "mitigated". Opening postmortem ticket. Initial notes: root cause = provider quota exhaustion combined with autoscaler conservative cooldown + unfortunate model rollout that increased memory usage.
Nora (eng-ops): Adding action items: 1) add autoscaler guardrail to detect provider quota errors and auto-route to fallback region, 2) increase emergency quota runbook and automated cloud case opener, 3) add circuit-breaker to prevent large simultaneous model rollouts when pool utilization > 60%, 4) improve customer-facing status templates for capacity events.
Sam (ml-oncall): Add: validate model memory regression test in CI so rollout can't increase memory by >5% without flag.
Ravi (sre): I'll create a short-term policy to reduce `scale_cooldown` when queue growth rate > X and file a follow-up to audit scale limit config across regions.
Emma (cs): Will coordinate customer comms and follow-up outreach.
Asha (oncall): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene for a 30m post-incident review at 20:40 UTC (thread pinned). If anyone has logs or snippets, paste them here.
Ravi (sre): Pasted key autoscaler trace: ```2026-03-15T20:05:11Z ERROR autoscaler.go: request rejected: InstanceLimitExceeded region=north-eu```
Tomas (infra): Provider case #CLOUD-18472 link: https://provider.support/cases/18472 (internal ticket).
Nora (eng-ops): Filed follow-up GH: infra/ops#2431 - "Autoscaler: handle provider quota and fallback routing".
Asha (oncall): Closing initial incident thread; moving to postmortem. Final status: mitigated, partial customer impact (short-term degraded performance for embed-heavy customers), hotfix and routing changes applied, follow-ups tracked. :white_check_mark:
